name: The Ogres of Feralas
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The effects of the Gordunni Ogre tribe can hardly go unnoticed in this area. Look around, adventurer; their very presence scars this land. We must push them back before they expand even further into Feralas.

Follow the river north, and you will find their outpost. Decrease their numbers, adventurer. We must show them that their kind is not wanted here.
narrative.objectives: Rok Orhan in Camp Mojache wants you to kill 10 Gordunni Ogres, 10 Gordunni Ogre-Magi, and 5 Gordunni Brutes.
narrative.offerRewardText: Excellent, adventurer. In time, the land will heal. We must not give up.
narrative.requestItemsText: Move swiftly, adventurer. Or is the task I requested too difficult?
